# herdsman checkpointer

<!-- Generated by make docs. Change the source it names and regenerate. -->

Checkpoint the orchestrator's memory and compact it: TARGET=<pane> checkpointer [--once|--probe] | checkpointer guard <name> <pane>.

## herdsman checkpointer guard

```text
usage: herdsman checkpointer guard <orchestrator-name> <pane>

A read-only check, right before each input in adjutant mode: the approved
registry names <pane> as <orchestrator-name>, and its live session still
matches. Settings (environment): HERDSMAN_INBOX (required),
HERDSMAN_PREFLIGHT.

Exit codes:
  0  OK <orchestrator-name> <pane>
  2  usage, a bad setting, or a refusal (the reason on stderr)
```
